mustFix.evidence: Frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v28 at the corresponding field says the v27 findings land at v28. The v28 to v29 leaf diff changes that target to v29 even though v29's purpose is to land only the new v28 finding CLAUDE-G21FXV28-M-1. The established recorded shape also preserves historical findingDisposition targets: dual-ACCEPTed g21-fixture-corpus.v25 keeps v20 findings at v21, v22 findings at v23, and v23 findings at v24 while only v24 findings land at v25.
mustFix.why: A findings landing is historical custody, not a speaker token. Advancing it makes v29 claim a second landing for findings already discharged in v28, contradicts the candidate's basedOn authority, and violates the dispatch's explicit no-rewrite constraint. This is the same lineage-integrity class that earlier g21-fixture-corpus reviews treated as rejecting.
